description: This file defines the Route53RecoveryClusterClient class which extends AwsClient, designed to interact with the AWS Route53 Recovery Cluster service. It includes method annotations for actions such as retrieving and updating routing control states, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: Route53RecoveryClusterClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient, used to perform operations on the Route53 Recovery Cluster service.

methods.name: getRoutingControlState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a routing control.

methods.name: getRoutingControlStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current state of a routing control.

methods.name: listRoutingControlsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists the routing controls available.

methods.name: updateRoutingControlState
methods.description: Updates the state of a routing control.

methods.name: updateRoutingControlStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the state of a routing control.

methods.name: updateRoutingControlStatesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates multiple routing control states.
